note: Reel 37: You're the Thief (working title). Draft 8. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart, 1.0). Lines that need a real pause are their own lines. Facts: docs/research.md. Five voice runs: 43373776324, 43375946862, 43444575946, 43445439756, 43451862354; every run's takes are in audio/vo_lab/takes (earlier takes of a reworded line are kept beside it as <id>_runN). What the runs and the reviews changed: 'Pick who you rob' ran together with 'You're the thief' (ear 1: 'Pekuyu Rob'), so the first line is two lines. 'Picked someone else?' lost its t in every take, and 'You'd make a bad thief' was heard as 'you make' through a phone speaker, so that line is 'Didn't pick three? You're a bad thief.' 'Trust your gut.' (n02p) is said inside the three-second clock, so the voice stays with the viewer through the test. After two fresh reviews (13 Nov): 'So what did you go by?' became 'So how did you pick?' ('go by' is 'go buy' to the ear, after bag and phone), and the three sentences are three lines; 'easy to mug' became 'easy to rob' ('mug' mostly means cram in Indian English, and the film says rob everywhere else); 'They picked walks like number three's.' became 'They picked walks like this.' (a possessive on the key word; the caption says the same); 'Picked three? You just robbed...' became 'If you picked three, you just robbed a man for being tired.' (it sat right after 'Didn't pick three?' and was a question only by pitch). Voiced for comparison and not used (their takes are still in the lab folders): 'Pick who to rob.', 'They chose walks like number three's.', 'If you didn't pick three, you'd make a bad thief.', 'Picked three?' on its own, 'Don't think.', 'They're getting away.', 'Didn't pick three? Then you're a bad thief.', 'So how did you choose?', 'They picked walks like his.', 'And if you did? You just robbed a man for being tired.'
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Take everything else away, and you still know which one's yours.
Men in prison for assault were asked who looked easy to rob.
Didn't pick three? You're a bad thief.
If you picked three, you just robbed a man for being tired.
Everyone walks like that some days,
and the real thief is watching for the day you do.
